output.headline: Partners with Oakland Natives Give Back Fund on attendance incentives at no cost
output.summary: This no-cost memorandum of understanding (MOU) lets the Oakland Natives Give Back Fund run its Every Day Counts Attendance Challenge and Attendance Learning Institute at all district public schools. output.summary: The Achievement Network provides coaching and training for EnCompass Academy teachers to help students learn the English Language Arts Common Core standards. The contract and its addendum run from July 1, 2019 to June 30, 2020.

output.headline: Approves no-cost data sharing agreement with Oakland Enrolls to study enrollment patterns through 2023
output.summary: Oakland Enrolls, the charter application platform, will share student-level data with the district so the district can study enrollment patterns and prepare reports. Reports shared back to Oakland Enrolls will not include student-level or identifiable information. The agreement runs from February 27, 2020 through July 1, 2023 at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Directs the Board Secretary to cast the district's ballot for up to three California School Boards Association delegate candidates
output.summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that instructs the Secretary of the Governing Board to cast the district's ballot for up to three candidates for the California School Boards Association 2020 Delegate Assembly, Sub-Region 7-B (Alameda County). The ballot must be returned with a postmark on or before March 16, 2020. No dollar amount is stated.
